title: Fiber-seq for Flash Frozen Mouse Tissue for IGVF
author: Jasmine Sakr
materials: Make buffers and solutions Buffer A 0.5 Molarity (M) Spermidine and store at 4 °C 20 % (v/v) Sodium Dodecyl Sulfate (SDS) and store at Room temperature

steps.title: Prepare samples and reagents
steps.instruction: Keep flash‑frozen tissue samples on dry ice until lysis; spin 5 × 10⁶ nuclei at 250 × g, 4 °C for 5 min; add 20 µL Proteinase K and 10 µL RNase A to each tube; set two thermomixers at 56 °C and 25 °C.

substeps.instruction: Add Proteinase K (20 µL) and RNase A (10 µL).

steps.title: Label DNA extraction tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare and label: a bead‑strainer in a collection tube, a 2 mL tube for wash step, a 2 mL tube for elution step, and a 1.5 mL tube for final elution; add 150 µL gDNA Elution Buffer II to each 2 mL elution tube.

steps.title: Prepare ice bucket and chill reagents
steps.instruction: Place Proteinase K, RNase A, a pre‑chilled gentleMACS C tube, two 5 mL tubes, and 0.5 M Spermidine on ice.

steps.title: Add extraction buffer and tissue
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL Nuclei Extraction Buffer to the chilled gentleMACS C tube; drop whole frozen tissue into the tube, invert immediately to prevent tissue sticking, then load the tube onto the Octo Dissociator and place an Octo Cooler over it.

steps.title: Dissociate tissue
steps.instruction: Run gentleMACS program 4C_nuclei_1 on the Octo Dissociator for 00:05:00; remove the C tube, tap to release any tissue stuck to the sides, and spin down at 4 °C for 00:00:10.

steps.title: Collect nuclei suspension
steps.instruction: Mix the nuclei suspension thoroughly with a 5 mL pipet; filter through a 70 µm MACS SmartStrainer into a 5 mL tube; wash the empty C tube with an additional 2 mL Nuclei Extraction Buffer, swish, and filter this wash through the same 70 µm strainer into the same tube (total volume ≈4 mL).

steps.title: Prepare RSB and pellet nuclei
steps.instruction: Make enough RSB for all samples; centrifuge the 4 mL nuclei suspension at 350 × g, 4 °C for 5 min; remove supernatant without disturbing the pellet; resuspend pellet in 3 mL RSB; filter through a 30 µm MACS SmartStrainer into a new 5 mL tube; aliquot 5 × 10⁶ nuclei into 1.5 mL tubes.

steps.title: Prepare Reaction Master Mix
steps.instruction: During the 5‑min spin, mix Buffer A with Spermidine (room temperature) and keep on ice; mix Reaction Master Mix (75 U) on ice; keep the complete master mix on ice until use.

steps.title: Resuspend nuclei in Master Mix
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant and resuspend the nuclei pellet in 300 µL Reaction Master Mix buffer; incubate on a 25 °C heat block for 00:10:00.

steps.title: Add SDS and mix
steps.instruction: Add 15 µL of 20 % SDS to each sample (final SDS concentration = 1 %); gently invert to mix; then mix gently by pipetting with a wide‑bore tip (no vortexing).

steps.title: Protein separation incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate in a thermal mixer at 2000 rpm, 56 °C for 10 min; add 300 µL Protein Separation solution; mix on a vertical rotating mixer at 20 rpm, °C for 1 min; centrifuge at 16 000 × g, °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Transfer aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Using a wide‑bore tip, transfer as much of the upper (aqueous) phase containing DNA to a labeled, empty 2 mL tube without disturbing the pellet at the bottom.

steps.title: Bind DNA to beads
steps.instruction: Add 2 DNA capture beads to each sample; add 425 µL isopropanol; mix on a vertical rotating mixer at 10 rpm, °C for 10 min to allow DNA to bind to the beads.

steps.title: First bead wash
steps.instruction: Discard liquid by keeping the tube upright, inserting a pipette tip and gently pushing beads aside; add 500 µL Wash Buffer; invert the tube gently 3 times.

steps.title: Second bead wash
steps.instruction: Discard liquid as above; add 500 µL Wash Buffer; invert gently 3 times.

steps.title: Third bead wash
steps.instruction: Discard liquid as above; add 500 µL Wash Buffer; invert gently 3 times.

steps.title: Collect beads
steps.instruction: Pour the beads into the bead retainer that sits in a collection tube; pulse‑spin (≤ 1 s) to remove residual wash buffer; separate the bead retainer from the collection tube and transfer the beads into a labeled tube containing 150 µL elution buffer; retain the bead retainer for a later step.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Incubate on a thermal mixer at 56 °C for 00:10:00, tilting the tube almost horizontally and gently shaking after the first 5 min; then incubate at room temperature for 01:00:00 (or at 4 °C overnight) to homogenize DNA; pour the eluate and the glass beads into the bead retainer placed in the final labeled tube; centrifuge at 12 000 rpm, °C for 30 s to separate eluate from glass beads; mix gently by pipetting with a wide‑bore tip.

steps.title: Proceed to library preparation
steps.instruction: Follow the “ONT Library Prep for Whole Genome Sequencing” protocol to build libraries for Oxford Nanopore sequencing.

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration of each tube with a Qubit fluorometer; keep tubes on ice until library preparation or store at –20 °C.
